test_MixtureOfTwo_jitable: test that MixtureOfTwo log_prob works correctly when wrapped in a JAX JIT compiled function
test_MixtureOfTwo_prob_a_prob_b: test the MixtureOfTwo prob_a and prob_b properties return the correct mixture proportions
test_MixtureOfTwo_batch_and_event_shape: test the MixtureOfTwo batch_shape and event_shape properties return expected shapes
test_MixtureOfTwo_invalid_parameters: test that MixtureOfTwo raises ValueError for mismatched event shape, batch shape, or dtype
